networkAccess.reasoning: Loads the Noto Sans web font for the brand type ramp. Dual File Mode reads the library files the user configures (variables, components, styles) from the Figma REST API. UX AI and the UX AI agents send questions, the text of reviewed layers and matching library context to the provider the user picks in Settings (Claude at api.anthropic.com, OpenAI at api.openai.com, Gemini at generativelanguage.googleapis.com) with the user’s own API key. Publish commits releases (token JSON, release notes, changelog) to the GitHub repository the user configures, opens the pull request and follows its Actions run with the user’s own token (api.github.com). With "Post the changelog to Teams" ticked, Publish posts the changelog to the Teams Incoming Webhook (*.webhook.office.com) or Power Automate trigger (*.logic.azure.com) set in Settings › Notifications. In development the Jira tab calls the local Jira proxy on localhost:8787.
